blocks.en: Phase VI of the “Three-North” Shelterbelt Program

blocks.zh: 围绕筑牢北方生态安全屏障，打好黄河“几字弯”攻坚战、科尔沁和浑善达克沙地歼灭战、河西走廊—塔克拉玛干沙漠边缘阻击战，实现“三北”工程区林草覆盖率达到40.9%，可治理沙化土地治理率达到67%，沙化土地综合植被盖度达到22%，促进黄河重点生态区、北方防沙带、东北森林带生态保护修复。
blocks.en: With the aim of consolidating the northern ecological security shield, battles will be won at the Yellow River “Jizi Bend”, in the Horqin and Hunshandake sandy lands, and in the blocking battle along the edge of the Hexi Corridor–Taklimakan Desert; forest and grass coverage in the program area will reach 40.9 percent; the treatment rate of treatable desertified land will reach 67 percent; comprehensive vegetation coverage on desertified land will reach 22 percent; and ecological protection and restoration will be promoted in the Yellow River key ecological area, the northern sand prevention belt and the northeast forest belt.

blocks.zh: 青藏高原生态屏障区生态保护和修复
blocks.en: Ecological Protection and Restoration in the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau Ecological Barrier Area

blocks.zh: 以加快建设国家生态文明高地为目标，加强高原森林、草甸草原、雪山冰川冻土等保护，加大黑土滩型退化草原和沙化草原治理力度，推进沙化土地综合治理和重要湿地生态功能恢复，健全三江源“中华水塔”保护支持体系，完成退化草原修复250万公顷，沙化土地综合治理100万公顷。
blocks.en: Aiming to accelerate the building of a national ecological civilization highland, protection of plateau forests, meadow grasslands, snow-capped mountains, glaciers and frozen soil will be strengthened; greater efforts will be made to treat black-soil flat type degraded grasslands and desertified grasslands; comprehensive treatment of desertified land and restoration of the ecological functions of important wetlands will be advanced; the support system for protecting the Sanjiangyuan “China Water Tower” will be improved; 2.5 million hectares of degraded grassland will be restored; and 1 million hectares of desertified land will be comprehensively treated.

blocks.zh: 长江重点生态区生态保护和修复
blocks.en: Ecological Protection and Restoration in the Yangtze River Key Ecological Area

blocks.zh: 加强水土流失、石漠化综合治理，推动鄱阳湖、洞庭湖等河湖湿地生态保护和修复，实施森林抚育和低质低效林改造，新增水土流失治理面积600万公顷、石漠化土地治理面积130万公顷。
blocks.en: Comprehensive treatment of soil erosion and rocky desertification will be strengthened; ecological protection and restoration of rivers, lakes and wetlands such as Poyang Lake and Dongting Lake will be promoted; forest tending and the transformation of low-quality and inefficient forests will be carried out; and 6 million hectares of additional soil erosion control area and 1.3 million hectares of rocky desertification land treatment area will be added.

blocks.zh: 南方丘陵山地带生态保护和修复
blocks.en: Ecological Protection and Restoration in the Southern Hilly and Mountainous Belt

blocks.zh: 完善防护林体系，推动岩溶地区石漠化治理，加强重要湿地保护修复，持续提升南岭山地、武夷山、湘桂岩溶地区等重点区域生态质量，新增石漠化土地治理面积30万公顷，完成营造林11万公顷。
blocks.en: The shelterbelt system will be improved; rocky desertification control in karst areas will be advanced; important wetlands will be better protected and restored; the ecological quality of key areas such as the Nanling Mountains, the Wuyi Mountains and the Xiang-Gui karst area will be continuously improved; 300,000 hectares of additional rocky desertification land will be treated; and 110,000 hectares of afforestation will be completed.

blocks.zh: 海岸带生态保护和修复
blocks.en: Ecological Protection and Restoration of Coastal Zones

blocks.zh: 围绕建设人海和谐、安全韧性的海岸带生态安全屏障，修复受损退化岸滩和生态系统，开展浒苔绿潮等生态灾害综合治理，提升红树林、珊瑚礁、海草床等典型生态系统质量和稳定性，整治修复滨海湿地2万公顷，修复海岸线400公里。
blocks.en: With the aim of building a harmonious, safe and resilient coastal ecological security shield between people and the sea, damaged and degraded beaches and ecosystems will be restored; comprehensive treatment of ecological disasters such as green tides of Ulva prolifera will be carried out; the quality and stability of typical ecosystems such as mangroves, coral reefs and seagrass beds will be improved; 20,000 hectares of coastal wetlands will be renovated and restored; and 400 kilometers of coastline will be restored.

blocks.zh: 自然保护地体系建设与野生动植物保护
blocks.en: Building the Protected Areas System and Protecting Wild Animals and Plants

blocks.zh: 提升国家公园等自然保护地保护管理、科研监测、科普宣教等能力，推进上海辰山、西双版纳等国家植物园设立。加强野生动植物重要栖息地恢复和珍稀濒危野生动植物救护中心、种源繁育及野化放归等基地建设。
blocks.en: The capacity of national parks and other protected areas in protection and management, scientific research and monitoring, and science popularization and education will be enhanced, and the establishment of national botanical gardens such as Shanghai Chenshan and Xishuangbanna will be advanced. The restoration of important habitats for wild animals and plants will be strengthened, and bases such as rescue centers for rare and endangered wild animals and plants, germplasm breeding centers, and rewilding and release bases will be built.
